title: Response
description: An OpenAPI description object specifying one possible HTTP outcome of an operation for a single status code (or 'default'). It carries a required description and, optionally, response headers, a body content map keyed by MIME type, and links to follow-on operations. Use Responses instead when the element is the whole status-code-to-response map for an operation rather than a single outcome under one status code. Use MediaType instead when the element describes the schema, examples and encoding for one MIME type entry (e.g. application/json) inside a response's content map. Use Schema instead when the element defines only the data shape of a response body, independent of status code, headers or description. Use Header instead when the element defines one individual response header rather than the response that contains it.

description.description: Required human-readable explanation of what this outcome means (e.g. 'User not found'); CommonMark is permitted. Set it for every response, including those with no body.

x-dr-evidence: an @ApiResponse(responseCode="404", description=...) annotation in springdoc/Swagger, or a NestJS @ApiOkResponse/@ApiNotFoundResponse decorator on a controller method
an entry under a status-code key such as '200': or 'default': beneath an operation's 'responses' map, or under 'components/responses', in an openapi.yaml/json file
a FastAPI route declaring responses={404: {"description": ..., "model": ...}}, or a handler returning a fixed status code with a documented body or headers
